requirement: Team: Approve adds the requester at once in a picked role (no invitation); a waiting request stays under Unread after Review; a member who left reads Left; a team link stays on Team

oracle.ref: PR #878 (fix); fix evidence: On cowork.tracy.site 04/10: Approve opened the invite wizard ('Seats are granted when they accept'); Review hid a still-unanswered request from Unread; a member who left showed 'Revoked'; a View team / Review link landed on the Browser tab one click in two. After #878: the approved row read 'Granted 53 minutes ago', the time of the request.
oracle.invariant: The unit seams exit 0 with '# fail 0'. STILL === 1 and DB === 't|f' (read by Review, not settled, still listed under Unread). LEFT contains 'Left' and not 'Revoked'. DIALOG contains 'Approve request' and does not contain 'Seats are granted when they accept' or 'Send the invitation'. ROW contains 'Active' and 'Granted just now' (the approval time, not the request's); SEAT === 'editor|t'; T1 === '0'. Every ACTIVE sample starts with 'Team'; QUERY contains 'tab=tracy:team' and not 'open=my-sites'.
